thread:
Maya: Heads-up 0min review: p95 card prototype in staging — keyboard users report focus jumping into the sampling control mid-presets.

Sam: Repro?

Maya: Tab to presets row, press Right Arrow, focus drops into sampling slider (low contrast) instead of moving to actions.

Jon: DOM order issue. Sampling is before actions. Quick fix: move sampling into kebab/overflow so presets -> actions are linear.

Lee: Hiding sampling hurts discoverability. Can we add a single-key shortcut (e.g., `s`) that opens sampling while keeping it in overflow?

Olivia: Microcopy: replace "Sample rate (auto)" with "Sampling (data rate)" and make tooltip "Control sampling to reduce cost & noise". Aria label should include percent.

Aria: If moved: ensure overflow has `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded`, trap focus in dialog, restore focus on close, add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to p95 header when presets change, and for presets use `role=listbox` + `aria-activedescendant`.

Sam: I prefer move+shortcut (keeps UI clean and keyboard reachable). I'll add an E2E for `s` and an analytics event `ui.sampling.toggled` with source prop.

Jon: Prototype deployed to staging (build 44). Link in PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/789

design-bot: Preview updated 0min ago  keyboard-nav smoke tests triggered.

Maya: Action list: Jon update PR with listbox attrs; Olivia finalize copy; Aria sign-off; Sam add tests & analytics. Merge after green tests.

Lee: Also please log where the toggle came from (inline vs overflow) to measure discoverability.

Sam: Will include `source` field in the event.

Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
